game.title: Murdered: Soul Suspect
game.blurb: Ghost detective action-adventure from Airtight Games (RAWG also lists Square Enix), published by Square Enix, released 2014-06-03. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story: First Steps
chapters.summary: The early story milestones, from the first street investigation to the church. Hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Story: Closing In
chapters.summary: The later story milestones, from the graveyard to the end of the story. Hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Ghost Powers and Investigation
chapters.summary: Learning Reveal, Remove, Mind Read, Poltergeist and Teleport, possessing the cat, interrogating a ghost, beating a demon and the first investigation.

chapters.title: Side Cases
chapters.summary: Helping the ghosts Ingrid, Julie, Brad and Katy find peace.

chapters.title: Artifacts
chapters.summary: Collecting artifacts, from the first one up to all of them.

chapters.title: Life Stories and Salem's Past
chapters.summary: Full sets that tell the stories of Ronan, Baxter, Rex, Cassandra, Julia and the Bell Killer, plus Salem's history, the witch trials and the supernatural graffiti.

chapters.title: Ghost Stories
chapters.summary: The ghost story sets hidden around the town, the apartment, the church, the police station, the graveyard, the asylum, the museum and the Judgement House.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 233290)
StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (murdered.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://murdered.fandom.com/wiki/Murdered:_Soul_Suspect
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3427). Steam app 233290 ("MURDERED: SOUL SUSPECT™" in the schema) was used. StrategyWiki has no page under "Murdered: Soul Suspect" or "Murdered Soul Suspect". murdered.fandom.com answers the API under "Murdered: Soul Suspect" with 11 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 10 of 48 Steam achievements are hidden; their API names carry episode numbers (FA_BeginEp02 to FA_EndEp09, then FA_DefeatedAbigail), which were used to split them: Ep02 to Ep04 go in the first story chapter and Ep05 onward (plus the last one) in the second, a reasoned split by API name. The ghost story locations come from the achievement API names (Apartment, Church, PoliceStation, Graveyard, Asylum, Museum, JudgementHouse, Town); their order in the game is not in the data.
